shared_elements: incised/low-relief carved signs on a flat stone surface
row or band of small sign-like marks running horizontally
possible schematic figural or curvilinear motifs in shallow relief
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow incised sign-like marks arranged in roughly horizontal bands, and both appear to use a schematic, outline-incised convention rather than modelled naturalism. But A shows an explicit and specific scene — two standing human figures in profile facing each other across an offering stand, above several ruled registers of small dense signs — while B offers only sparse, largely illegible curvilinear marks with no identifiable figures or comparable compositional scheme, so the correspondence is generic at best.
